'''Darth Simi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Priest/Legends|priestess]]<ref name="Visions" /> affiliated with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]].<ref name="Sith" /> She was [[Immortality/Legends|kept alive]] for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] through a process of sacrificing young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;the ideological antithesis of the Sith&mdash;to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. At one point, Simi scoured [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for her next victim.<ref name="Visions" />

[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Simi was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] with light [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin and black geometric-patterned [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] that covered her head, torso, [[Limb/Legends|legs]], and hands. The Sith's dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]] was arranged in a mass of tendril-like braids extending from the top of her head. Simi was skilled in the [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|use]] of [[Jar'Kai/Legends|twin]] [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsabers]].<ref name="Visions" />

Simi wore a long brown [[Clothing/Legends|coat]] with an ornamented collar; a brown skirt; a wide brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]]; and brown straps across her [[Stomach/Legends|abdomen]] and [[Breast/Legends|chest]]. She carried two paired [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] that each had a short [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] and produced two [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|short]] yellow blades.<ref name="Visions" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Simi was created by [[Dorian Cleavenger]], who in [[2009]] depicted her in a painting that was included in the [[2010]] book ''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]'', which collected works by various artists inspired by the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise.<ref name="Visions" />
